Brand guide

Saarthee · સારથી. Report it. Track it. See it fixed.

The mark

A road rises from the lower left, turns right and runs on to a sunrise dot, the destination: "the way forward". Rounded square, radius 28% of its size, in primary #14674A. Master: docs/brand/mark.svg.

Lockups: mark and wordmark side by side, one language each. Never stack English over Gujarati.

Do and don’t

check_circle Do

  • Use the full-colour mark on white, #F3F6F1 or dark #131C18; on primary use mark-reversed.
  • Keep 25% of the mark size clear on every side.
  • Put English and Gujarati side by side, or swap them by locale.
  • Show the independence line wherever AMC is mentioned.

block Don’t

  • Recolour the mark or the dot (no AMC bronze, amber, navy or teal).
  • Stack English over Gujarati.
  • Add a seal, circle emblem, wheel, chakra or building.
  • Rotate, outline, add shadows to or stretch the mark.
  • Use "AMC" in the app name, icon or store title.

Sunrise appears at most once per screen, only on the Report action. Everything else that is interactive uses primary.

Typography

Baloo Bhai 2 for display and headings (never below 16 sp), Mukta Vaani for body, labels and buttons. Both are by Ek Type, OFL, and cover Gujarati and Latin.

displaySmallBaloo Bhai 2 28/36 · 700Namaste, Keyur · નમસ્તે
